title: Unite leader tells Labour to ‘stop being embarrassed’ to be voice of workers
summary: General secretary of party’s main union backer says it must change course or risk sowing seeds of its own destruction Unite’s general secretary, Sharon Graham, has told the government it must do more for workers in 2026 or risk sowing the seeds of its own destruction. Graham accused Labour of being preoccupied with its “failing leadership” and described the debate about who might replace Keir Starmer as inevitable. Continue reading...

title: ‘Zack is a phenomenal leader’: Siân Berry on the Green party’s next steps as membership doubles
summary: Since Zack Polanski took over as leader, the party has doubled its membership and its four MPs want to take on Reform’s anger and build community spirit “Someone has to be out there making the narrative for social security. Someone has to fight the corrosive attitudes to people on benefits,” says Siân Berry, who has just finished her first year as a Green MP in the House of Commons. She is speaking to the Guardian in her Brighton constituency office, formerly occupied by the legendary Caroline Lucas who flew a lone flag as the only member of parliament for the Green party for 14 years. Continue reading...
